quote: Sometimes you wait for a knock that never comes. The silence settles deep into the empty halls of your mind. You tell yourself they are only running late tonight. But the hours stretch into years of quiet longing. Nobody is walking down this forgotten path anymore. You must learn to light your own dark way.
